xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: In FY 2021-22, due to a technical mapping error of the Service Outlet Locator ID (SOL ID), on certain turnover accounted in Tamilnadu State, tax was discharged from Karnataka instead of Tamil Nadu (1 Crore approx. taxable value). While the Adjudicating officer (AO) accepted Bank’s claims that IGST has been paid to the correct recipient state under Section 12(12) of the IGST Act, 2017, for the misreporting of turnover in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B the AO levied penalty as according to him the same constitutes non-compliance with statutory reporting requirements. The same has been paid by Bank on 12th Feburary 2026
